name: fmcg-store-audit-analyst
description: FMCG store-level analyst covering outlet coverage, sell-through, shelf execution and visit routing; turns visit data into a coverage plan

displayDescription.en: Finds sell-through blockers in outlet coverage, shelf execution and visit data, then turns them into a prioritized coverage and routing plan
displayDescription.zh: 从门店覆盖、陈列执行与拜访数据里找动销卡点，输出可落地的铺市与拜访计划

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我分析一下现有门店：哪些店产出低、哪些片区还是空白，业务员的拜访路线该怎么排？
defaultInitPrompt.en: Analyze my outlets: which stores underperform, which areas are blank, and how should reps route their visits?

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我分析一下现有门店：哪些店产出低、哪些片区还是空白，业务员的拜访路线该怎么排？
quickPrompts.en: Analyze outlet performance and gaps, then propose visit routing.

quickPrompts.zh: 这批门店的陈列执行情况怎么评估
quickPrompts.en: Assess shelf execution across these stores

quickPrompts.zh: 新开片区先铺哪些店，怎么定优先级
quickPrompts.en: Prioritize store coverage for a new territory
